40837115.title: Alma Jodorowsky
40837115.extract: Alma Jodorowsky (born 26 September 1991) is a French actress, singer, and fashion model.

40477602.title: Anzalna Nasir
40477602.extract: Nur Anzalna Md Nasir (born 9 January 1988) is a Malaysian actress and commercial model.

25276055.title: Ariana Grande
25276055.extract: Ariana Grande-Butera (born June 26, 1993) is an American singer, songwriter, and actress. Known for her four-octave vocal range, which extends into the whistle register, she is an influential figure in popular music.

41697897.title: Beau Dunn
41697897.extract: Beau Dunn (born Brittany Beau Dunn; June 10, 1987, in Los Angeles, California) is an American actress, model, visual artist and entrepreneur. based in Los Angeles, California.

34962340.title: Calu Rivero
34962340.extract: Carla Soledad "Calu" Rivero (born 5 April 1987) is an Argentine actress and model.

42259479.title: Elena Nikolaeva (journalist)
42259479.extract: Elena Sergeevna Nikolaeva (Russian: Елена Сергеевна Николаева, born 25 December 1985 in Tashkent) is a Russian journalist. She has also performed episodic roles in several films.

49826893.title: Giulia Arena
49826893.extract: Giulia Arena (born 22 April 1994) is an Italian beauty queen, actress, television presenter and model, winner of the 74th edition of Miss Italia 2013.

75223389.title: Indira Joshi (singer)
75223389.extract:
Indira Joshi (Nepali: इन्दिरा जोशी) is a Nepalese singer and has been a judge on Nepal Idol, and for Miss Universe Nepal 2021.
Her hit songs have included "Udhreko Choli" and "Rato Ghanghara".

40690873.title: Jakelyne Oliveira
40690873.extract: Jakelyne de Oliveira Silva (born March 18, 1993, in Rondonópolis) is a Brazilian dancer, model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Brazil 2013 and represented her country at Miss Universe 2013 in Moscow, Russia. In September 2020 she joined the cast of the reality show A Fazenda.

40806346.title: Jamie Brewer
40806346.extract: Jamie Brewer (born 1984 or 1985) is an American actress and model. She is best known for her roles in the FX horror anthology television series American Horror Story.

41107548.title: Jourdan Miller
41107548.extract: Jourdan Miller (born October 6, 1993) is an American fashion model, best known for winning the twentieth cycle of America's Next Top Model. She is also the only female contestant to have won a cycle that included male contestants; the other two cycles that followed were both won by male contestants.

19754987.title: Kat Graham
19754987.extract: Katerina Alexandre Hartford Graham (born September 5, 1989) is a Swiss-born American actress, singer, and dancer. She played Bonnie Bennett on the CW supernatural drama series The Vampire Diaries (2009–2017).

40530548.title: Madison Beer
40530548.extract: Madison Elle Beer (born March 5, 1999) is an American singer-songwriter and television personality. Beer first gained media attention after Justin Bieber posted a link to her cover of "At Last" in 2012, when she was 13 years old.

50332885.title: Mariluz Bermúdez
50332885.extract: Mariluz Bermúdez Garnier is a Costa Rican television actress and model, known for her roles in the telenovelas Camaleones, Mentir para vivir, Corona de lágrimas and La Gata.

41056041.title: Paulina Vega
41056041.extract: Paulina Vega Dieppa (Spanish pronunciation: [pawˈlina ˈβeɣa]; born January 15, 1993) is a Colombian model, business administrator and beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Universe 2014, she previously won Miss Colombia 2013. Vega was the second Miss Universe from Colombia.

64400274.title: Rainey Qualley
64400274.extract: Rainsford Dubose Qualley (born March 11, 1989) is an American actress and singer. The daughter of actress Andie MacDowell and the sister of actress Margaret Qualley, she made her acting debut in the 2012 film Mighty Fine.

40668358.title: Sabrina Seara
40668358.extract: Sabrina Seara Parra (born 27 March 1985 in Caracas, Venezuela) is a Venezuelan telenovela actress.

22946653.title: Shraddha Kapoor
22946653.extract: Shraddha Kapoor (born 3 March 1987) is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi films. One of India's highest-paid actresses, Kapoor has been featured in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list since 2014 and was featured by Forbes Asia in their 30 Under 30 list of 2016.

40906853.title: Yanna Lavigne
40906853.extract: Yanna Lavigne Inagaki Gissoni (born 29 November 1989) is a Brazilian television actress and model.

39737124.title: Yoon So-hee
39737124.extract: Yoon So-hee (Korean: 윤소희; born May 7, 1993) is a South Korean actress.
